name: Resend
description: Transactional email delivery for the compliance platform (notifications, sign-in links). Receives recipient addresses and message content at send time only; holds no platform data. Vendor — does not process customer data; not a sub-processor. Reviewed annually by the CEO per the Vendor Management Policy.

name: Google Workspace
description: Personnel email, calendar, and document storage for Deal Intelligence LLC, and the identity provider for personnel single sign-on with MFA enforced. Vendor — does not process customer data; not a sub-processor; customer Google sign-in is handled by PropelAuth. Reviewed annually by the CEO (SOC 2 report and terms) per the Vendor Management Policy.

name: GitHub
description: Source control for dealintelligence/di-backend-api, GitHub Actions CI, Dependabot, code and secret scanning, and branch protection on main. No customer data enters the repository or CI. Vendor — does not process customer data; not a sub-processor. Reviewed annually by the CEO (SOC 2 report and terms) per the Vendor Management Policy.

name: PropelAuth
description: Authentication and identity management for the Deal Intelligence platform: JWT issuance, Google Workspace single sign-on (customer MFA inherited from Google Workspace), RBAC, session management. Sub-processor under a Data Processing Agreement; carve-out in the SOC 2 examination. Reviewed annually by the CEO (SOC 2 report and terms) per the Vendor Management Policy.

name: Amazon Web Services
description: Cloud hosting and encrypted storage for the Deal Intelligence platform in us-east-1: Lambda, Fargate, DocumentDB, S3, CloudFront, VPC, KMS, CloudTrail, EventBridge, SNS. Sub-processor under a Data Processing Agreement; carve-out in the SOC 2 examination. Reviewed annually by the CEO (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 reports and terms) per the Vendor Management Policy.
